decisions.reason: The vegan superfood drink mix sits far outside the firm's chemical and waste-to-energy competence, and after only a brief website mention it shows little sign of value, so this weakly supported option is best abandoned to free resources for the core plant business.
Modular plant extensions fit the firm's waste-to-energy line, their value is still uncertain after one year, and keeping them as an add-on costs little, so the option is worth holding open.
The waste oil to energy plant has its own dedicated page, which signals stronger commitment and early promise in the core field, so management should keep it while uncertainty about demand resolves.

Plastic-waste-to-fuel is a technologically uncertain but potentially valuable option close to the core business, and with only a low-cost mention so far it should stay open until results show whether it can succeed.
